title: How to Generate Real Estate Leads in India (Without the Junk Leads)
seoTitle: How to Generate Real Estate Leads in India
excerpt: Where real estate leads come from in India — portals, Meta and Google ads, CPs, referrals — free methods for brokers, and how to stop paying for junk leads.
imageAlt: A man in a suit talking on a desk phone in his office

inlineImages.alt: A property advisor going through papers with a young couple inside an apartment

faqs.question: How can I generate real estate leads in India?
faqs.answer: Combine a few sources: property portals, your own Meta and Google ads sent to a project landing page, channel partners, referrals and a Google Business Profile. Then judge each source on cost per site visit rather than the number of enquiries.

faqs.question: How do I get real estate leads for free?
faqs.answer: Set up a Google Business Profile, ask every past buyer for referrals, post walkthrough and locality videos with your WhatsApp number, work with developers as a registered channel partner, and reply instantly to every enquiry you already receive.

faqs.question: Why are my real estate leads junk?
faqs.answer: Usually because forms are too easy to submit, the ad doesn’t show the price band, the platforms are optimising for form fills, Google ads match irrelevant searches, or the lead was called too late. Each has a fix: qualifying questions, visible prices, sending site-visit data back to the platforms, negative keywords and instant WhatsApp replies.

faqs.question: Are Facebook leads fake?
faqs.answer: Mostly not. Many are real people who submitted an instant form with little thought, or were not contacted quickly. Higher-intent forms, qualifying questions and a reply within seconds usually improve Meta lead quality.

faqs.question: Where do real estate agents get the most leads?
faqs.answer: In India, most brokers rely on portals, developer-shared leads and referrals. Portal leads are often shared with other brokers, so more agents now add their own ads and project pages to get leads nobody else receives.

faqs.question: Should I buy real estate leads or phone number databases?
faqs.answer: Avoid bought number lists: the people never agreed to be contacted, promotional calls to DND numbers can breach TRAI rules, and the DPDP Act, 2023 requires consent. Pay-per-lead services that run their own ads are different, but ask if leads are exclusive and judge them on site visits.

faqs.question: How quickly should I respond to a property lead?
faqs.answer: Within minutes, ideally seconds. Buyers enquire with several projects the same evening, and the first to reply with the price sheet and a visit slot usually gets the visit. A WhatsApp chatbot makes that possible at any hour.

faqs.question: How should I measure real estate lead generation?
faqs.answer: Track spend, enquiries, contacted, qualified, site visits and bookings for every source, and compare sources on cost per site visit. Move budget monthly towards the cheapest source of visits.
